summary.one_liner: feedparser is a Python library that parses RSS, Atom, and JSON feeds into a uniform data structure.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes feedparser as a universal feed parser for RSS, Atom, and JSON feeds in Python. It is installed from PyPI with pip. The documentation is hosted on the web and can also be built locally with tox into HTML under build/docs/. The project ships a test suite run through tox, with a parallel option. The README itself is short and focuses on installation, docs, and testing, so it gives little detail on the parsing API.
use_cases: build a feed reader or aggregator
extract items from blog or news feeds
notable: Handles RSS, Atom, and JSON feed formats through one parser
Installable from PyPI with a single pip command
Extensive test suite run with tox
Documentation can be built locally with tox
caveats: The README does not describe the API or usage examples; see the web documentation
Listed under web scraping in awesome-python, but it parses feeds rather than scraping HTML pages
